2010.title: Part B 图表作文：手机用户量增长情况对比
2010.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the changes in mobile-phone subscriptions from 2000 to 2008. During this period, subscriptions in developing countries rose sharply from 0.5 billion to 4 billion. By contrast, the figure for subscriptions in developed countries saw a modest increase, climbing from 0.7 billion to 1 billion over the same period. The two moved in the same direction, but not at the same pace.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, as household incomes have grown, mobile phone use has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Equally important, online platforms and mobile payment have made mobile phone use quicker and easier to arrange. Beyond that, people now judge mobile phone use by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
2010.apply_cn:
该柱状图清晰地展示了2000年到2008年期间手机用户数的变化。在此期间，发展中国家的手机用户数从5亿急剧增至40亿。相比之下，发达国家的手机用户数仅略有增加，从7亿攀升至10亿。两者方向一致，但速度不同。

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，随着家庭收入提高，手机已从奢侈品变成日常必需。同样重要的是，线上平台和移动支付使手机变得更快、更方便。除此之外，如今，人们评判手机的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。

总的来说，这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分的理由相信，这一趋势将在未来几年继续发展。

2011.title: Part B 图表作文：汽车品牌市场份额变化
2011.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the sharp contrast in the market shares of Chinese, Japanese and American car brands between Chinese brands and Japanese brands from 2008 to 2009. During this period, Chinese brands rose sharply from 26% to 31%. By contrast, the figure for Japanese brands saw a steady decline, falling from 35% to 26%.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, people now judge car ownership by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Equally important, public spending on infrastructure has made car ownership far more widely available. Beyond that, domestic producers have narrowed the quality gap, so buyers no longer pay a premium for foreign brands.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Companies can make domestic car brands cheaper and easier to use, so that they reach more people. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，如今，人们评判汽车保有量的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。同样重要的是，基础设施方面的公共支出使汽车保有量更加普及。除此之外，国产品牌缩小了质量差距，消费者不再愿意为外国品牌支付溢价。

总的来说，这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。企业可以让国产汽车品牌更低价、更便捷，从而让更多人能够使用。明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分的理由相信，这一趋势将在未来几年继续发展。

2012.title: Part B 图表作文：某公司员工工作满意度调查
2012.apply_en:
The table above clearly illustrates how employee dissatisfaction is distributed. The figure varies sharply from group to group: it stands at 64% for the 41-to-50 age group, but falls to just 10% for the group over 50. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, longer working hours have made people value the little free time they have. Equally important, young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently. Beyond that, people now judge job satisfaction by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, the figures point to a problem worth taking seriously. Employers should find out why experienced staff are the least satisfied, not just look at the overall figure. A company that ignores this gap will lose the very people it most depends on. Individuals need to watch their own habits instead of assuming they are safe. Unless effective measures are taken, it may well get worse.
2012.apply_cn:
该表格清晰地展示了员工的不满意比例的分布情况。组与组之间差别悬殊：41~50岁组高达64%，而50岁以上组只有10%。最大项与最小项之间差距很大。

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，工作时间变长，人们更看重仅有的空闲时间。同样重要的是，如今的年轻人比父辈换工作频繁得多，「忠诚」的意义也随之改变。除此之外，如今，人们评判工作满意度的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。

总的来说，这些数据指向一个不容忽视的问题。雇主应弄清为什么资深员工最不满意，而不是只看总体数字。忽视这一差距的公司，会失去它最依赖的那批人。个人需要留意自己的习惯，而不是想当然认为没问题。若不采取有效措施，问题很可能进一步恶化。

2013.title: Part B 大作文：大学生兼职比例柱状图
2013.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the changes in the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs from the first year to the final year. During this period, it rose steadily from 67.77% to 88.24%, without any noticeable fall. Growth was slow at first and then sped up.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, schools now treat part-time work as part of the routine rather than an optional extra. Equally important, employers now look for experience as much as for grades. Beyond that, people now judge part-time work by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Schools can build part-time work into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
2013.apply_cn:
该柱状图清晰地展示了大一到大四期间大学生兼职比例的变化。在此期间，它从67.77%稳步升至88.24%，始终没有明显回落。增长起初缓慢，后来明显加快。

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，学校现在将兼职视为常规活动的一部分，而非可选的附加内容。同样重要的是，如今用人单位既看重成绩，也看重经验。除此之外，如今，人们评判兼职的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。

总的来说，这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。学校可以把兼职融入日常安排，而非当作额外的任务。家庭的作用最为关键：孩子模仿的是大人的行动，而非说教。鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分的理由相信，这一趋势将在未来几年继续发展。

2014.title: Part B 大作文：城市与乡村人口的变化
2014.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the sharp contrast in the urban and rural population between the urban population and the rural population from 1990 to 2010. During this period, the urban population rose sharply from 300 million to 666 million. By contrast, the figure for the rural population saw a steady decline, falling from 834 million to 674 million.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, cities have absorbed millions of new residents, and demand for city living has grown with them. Equally important, as household incomes have grown, city living has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Beyond that, people now judge city living by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Government can fund public facilities so that city living is not limited to those who can pay. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

该柱状图清晰地展示了1990年到2010年期间城乡人口在城镇人口与乡村人口之间的鲜明反差。在此期间，城镇人口从3亿急剧增至6.66亿。相比之下，乡村人口则稳步下降，从8.34亿降至6.74亿。

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，随着城市吸纳了大量新居民，城市生活的需求也随之增长。同样重要的是，随着家庭收入提高，城市生活已从奢侈品变成日常必需。除此之外，如今，人们评判城市生活的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。

总的来说，这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。政府可以为公共设施提供资金，使城市生活不再局限于那些有支付能力的人。明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分的理由相信，这一趋势将在未来几年继续发展。

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, as household incomes have grown, New Year gifts have moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd. 2018.apply_en:
The pie chart above clearly illustrates how the factors consumers weigh when choosing a restaurant are distributed. Distinctive features take the lead, accounting for 36.3%, followed by service and the dining environment at 26.8% and 23.8% respectively, while other factors come last at 4.7%. Taken together, the three largest items make up 86.9%.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, as household incomes have grown, dining out has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Equally important, people now judge dining out by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Beyond that, online platforms and mobile payment have made dining out quicker and easier to arrange.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Companies can make dining out cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people. Platforms should design simple, honest services instead of ones that hold users’ attention for as long as possible. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，随着家庭收入提高，外出就餐已从奢侈品变成日常必需。同样重要的是，如今，人们评判外出就餐的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。除此之外，线上平台和移动支付使外出就餐变得更快、更方便。

2019.title: Part B 大作文：某高校2013年和2018年本科毕业生去向统计柱状图
2019.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the sharp contrast in graduates' destinations between the share going on to further study and the employment share from 2013 to 2018. During this period, the share going on to further study rose sharply from 26.3% to 34.0%. By contrast, the figure for the employment share saw a steady decline, falling from 68.1% to 60.7%.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, schools now treat career planning as part of the routine rather than an optional extra. Equally important, people now judge career planning by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Beyond that, young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Schools can build career planning into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. What matters most is whether families and schools treat career planning as a normal part of life. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，学校现在将职业规划视为常规活动的一部分，而非可选的附加内容。同样重要的是，如今，人们评判职业规划的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。除此之外，如今的年轻人比父辈换工作频繁得多，「忠诚」的意义也随之改变。

总的来说，这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。学校可以把职业规划融入日常安排，而非当作额外的任务。最关键的是，家庭和学校能否把职业规划当作日常生活的一部分。鉴于其背后的势头，我们有充分的理由相信，这一趋势将在未来几年继续发展。

2020.apply_en:
The pie chart above clearly illustrates how the purposes of mobile reading are distributed. Reading for knowledge takes the lead, accounting for 59.5%, followed by killing time and obtaining information at 21.3% and 17.0% respectively, while other purposes come last at 2.2%. Taken together, the three largest items make up 97.8%.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, online platforms and mobile payment have made mobile reading quicker and easier to arrange. Equally important, longer working hours have made people value the little free time they have. Beyond that, people now judge mobile reading by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Media should report on mobile reading honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks. Platforms should design simple, honest services instead of ones that hold users’ attention for as long as possible. Small habits matter: a little mobile reading every day adds up over a year. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

2022.title: Part B 大作文：2018—2020年我国快递业务量变动情况
2022.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the changes in express delivery volume from 2018 to 2020. During this period, the rural figure rose sharply from 12 billion pieces to 30 billion pieces. By contrast, the figure for the national total saw a modest increase, climbing from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces over the same period. The gap between the two widened over the period.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, technology has cut the cost of online shopping and put it within reach of far more people. Equally important, online platforms and mobile payment have made online shopping quicker and easier to arrange. Beyond that, cities have absorbed millions of new residents, and demand for online shopping has grown with them.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

The line chart above clearly illustrates the changes in the health literacy rate of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. During this period, it rose steadily from 8.80% to 25.40%, without any noticeable fall. Growth was slow at first and then sped up. The figure more than doubled over the period.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, public spending on infrastructure has made health literacy far more widely available. Equally important, people now judge health literacy by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Beyond that, sitting all day has turned health literacy from a hobby into a practical need.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Media should report on health literacy honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

2025.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the leisure activities of the elderly are distributed. Watching television takes the lead, accounting for 90.8%, followed by taking walks and planting flowers at 68.3% and 34.7% respectively, while playing chess comes last at 18.4%. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, longer life expectancy has changed how families plan for their later years. Equally important, as household incomes have grown, retirement life has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Beyond that, people now judge retirement life by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Small habits matter: a little leisure activity every day adds up over a year. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.

这一现象可归因于多种因素的综合作用。首先，寿命的延长改变了家庭对晚年的规划。同样重要的是，随着家庭收入提高，退休生活已从奢侈品变成日常必需。除此之外，如今，人们评判退休生活的标准是它能为自己带来什么，而非他人的看法。

2026.title: 图表作文：儿童户外活动的益处
2026.apply_en:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates how the perceived benefits of outdoor activities for children are distributed. Satisfying curiosity takes the lead, accounting for 54.6%, followed by improving observation skills and enhancing physical fitness at 54.5% and 33.2% respectively, while strengthening parent-child interaction comes last at 31.2%. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.

This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors. First, sitting all day has turned outdoor activity from a hobby into a practical need. Equally important, public spending on infrastructure has made outdoor activity far more widely available. Beyond that, people now judge outdoor activity by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a positive trend worth welcoming. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Schools can build outdoor activity into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Given the momentum behind it, there is every reason to believe that it will continue in the years ahead.
